title: Hangar
brief: Episode opener: zigzag armor room, outdoor courtyard with imps on ledges, secret rocket launcher path, computer room, and a clean exit. Teaches movement, secrets, outdoor vs indoor, and that ledges you see are often reachable later.
pacing_notes: Gentle escalate: empty-ish start, courtyard introduction of vertical enemies, secrets for explorers, short exit.

part_designs.shape: bent corridor forcing turns (not a straight tube)
part_designs.detail: Zigzag prevents spawn camping sightlines and makes the hangar feel built, not extruded.

part_designs.shape: small room with green armor focal pickup
part_designs.detail: Pickup as waypoint; armor signals upcoming damage without a cutscene.

part_designs.mobs: imps above as turrets; ground threats
part_designs.detail: First vertical combat lesson: look up; ledges create desire to explore upward paths/secrets.
Theme reinforcement via COMPUTE textures; niches invite checking every corner.

part_designs.shape: hidden path to early rocket launcher
part_designs.detail: Power fantasy for explorers; still skippable for critical path.
Readable end; no fake complexity after the courtyard lesson.
